attachments.fallback:
Hans Harisson commented on The Brainstorms Festival 2021 x NeuroTechX: "Pour infos, le message de Yannick :

We’ve tried to collaborate with them in the past on the “business” side of things with NeuroTechX Services, since they also offer consulting and recruiting. Always the kind of calls “yeah, let’s be friend…” but we both know we’re kinda competing.
Their festival is a good opportunity to promote NTX and show our activities. I’d encourage a 80/20 approach where we don’t over prepare but we don’t under deliver and look bad on all fronts (in front of them and more importantly in front of potential community members and collaborators).
The Festival is 3 day of ~3h each.
The Platform they are using is: <https://hopin.com/>
We should have a slide deck and/or a video that can run when no one is present.
Adam will be there for some time window.
We’re looking for someone from NTX to be there (at the booth). I was thinking, since it’s in Europe that Hans might be a good candidate? (I’ll let you handle this)
If we want to do something more formal as a talk, they can insert us in the program.
The conference isn’t free, but we can offer some free tickets to people for whom the price is a barrier.
The conference is going soon, so it’d be nice to move quick on this (we don’t have much to do, it’s mainly to them know that we’re in and if we want to be part of the program)

Please let me know it that’s something you can help with and I’ll connect you guys with the Brainstorms folks so you can be efficient in finding the right person who could represent NTX there.
Once again, the idea here is to play nice, to be good friend but we don’t have to “over do it”.
7:10
Thanks!"
